home.subtitle: Where are you going today?

lineDetail.approximateRoute: Approximate route: the official source does not publish this line's path; its stops are shown in order.
lineDetail.openInMap: View the line on the full map

stopDetail.title: Stop {{id}}
stopDetail.nextBusSoon: Next bus: real time coming soon

map.title: Map
map.mapLabel: Map of the Málaga bus lines
map.unsupported: This device cannot display the map. You can check the same lines and stops in the lists.
map.error: The map could not be loaded. Check your connection.
map.hint: Search for a line or stop, tap a route on the map or press “Highlight” in the list.

settings.title: Settings
settings.highContrastHint: Increases the contrast of text and controls. Works with both the light and the dark theme.

about.title: About
about.unofficialDetail: This is an independent project. For official information, check EMT Málaga's own channels.
about.dataSource: Lines, stops and routes come from the Málaga City Council open data portal (EMT Málaga).
about.dataDisclaimer: The data may contain errors or be out of date. Routes marked as approximate join the stops with straight lines.
about.privacy: There are no accounts or analytics, and the app asks for no permissions. It only stores your settings and the latest copy of the data on this device. To download the data and the map it connects to GitHub Pages and OpenFreeMap, which can see your IP address like any website.

data.unavailable: No data available. Check your connection and try again.
data.outdated: The data could not be updated. Showing data from {{date}}, which may be out of date.

plan.title: Get there
plan.locationSoon: Using your location as the starting point will come with “Near me”.
plan.samePlace: The start and the destination are the same place.
plan.noOptions: No lines go from the start to the destination, either direct or with one change.
plan.timesNote: Times from EMT's published timetable, not real time. The recommended option arrives first (or, with “Arrive by”, leaves latest).
plan.estimatedNote: A line in this option has no published timetable: its time is estimated from distance.
plan.nightNote: Includes a night line: it only runs at night.
plan.transferWalk: Change: get off at {{from}} and walk ~{{minutes}} min to {{to}}
plan.noService: no buses today or tomorrow per the timetable
plan.noServiceArrive: cannot arrive in time per the timetable

nextBus.unavailable: No timetable published for this line
nextBus.otherDay: No more buses today · next (timetable): {{day}} at {{time}}
